description: Deletes a knowledge entry: it leaves every list and search at once. The delete is restorable: it is saved as a new version, every earlier version stays, and restore_knowledge_version brings the entry back. Send the newest version number you read; if someone saved a newer version since, nothing is deleted and the answer is stale with the newest number.

expected_version.description: The entry's newest version number when you read it (read_knowledge or list_knowledge_versions gives it). If someone saved a newer version since, nothing changes and the answer is stale with the newest number: read the entry again first.

knowledge_id.description: The entry (list_knowledge and search_knowledge give ids).

project_id.description: The project the entry is in. May be left out: the entry's id finds its own project or the workspace.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: delete_knowledge
title: Delete a knowledge entry
